free_text_notes.physician_note: 67-year-old man with former smoker (40 pack-years), osteoporosis, admitted 2/25 with COPD exacerbation triggered by viral bronchitis. Ambulated 100 m with PT yesterday without desaturation.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Vitals stable this shift. Tolerating diet. The patient lives alone but has confirmed a daily check-in from a neighbour who has agreed to visit each morning. No safety concern was identified.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: CM following for discharge planning. 3/1 19:00: Prednisone taper: 30 mg x3 days, then 20 mg x3 days, then stop (was 40 mg daily) on evening rounds. Patient and daughter not yet told; this afternoon's teaching covered the old dose. Still waiting on pharmacy to finish the medication reconciliation. Original evening van slot cancelled; family will drive at the planned discharge time instead.
